div.div:
• Entities & Aggregate Roots: Encapsulate business logic, rules, and invariants
• Cyclic Object Pointers: Traverses rich relationships (order.customer.tier)
• Reference Identity: Memory reference equality (entityA === entityB)
• Clean Architecture: Pure domain models with zero database dependencies

div.div:
• Change Set Tracking: Registers entity mutations across the active business session
• Identity Buckets: [New] · [Dirty] · [Clean] · [Removed]
• Topological Dependency Ordering: Sorts statements by foreign key constraints
• Atomic Batch Commit: Flushes all queued DML statements in a single transaction

div.div:
• 1:1 In-Memory Guarantee: Exactly one object instance per database primary key
• Eliminates Redundant Reads: Repeated lookups resolve immediately from cache
• Prevents Overwrite Hazards: Eliminates stale in-memory state collisions
• Lookup Index: (Class, PrimaryKey) ➔ In-Memory Object Reference

div.div:
• 2D Normalized Relations: Structured tables with rigid columns, types, and constraints
• Foreign Key Integrity: Enforces parent/child relational integrity at storage engine
• Primary Key Identity: Numerical/UUID primary keys (orders.id = 42)
• ACID Transaction Boundary: Atomicity and write-ahead log (WAL) disk durability

div.div:
• The Object-Relational Impedance Bridge: Mediates bidirectionally between in-memory object graphs and relational table rows
• Schema Decoupling: Domain entities contain zero SQL strings, table schemas, column names, or database dependencies
• Object Reconstitution: Hydrates domain entities enforcing business invariants without firing spurious business events
